evidence: All 6 required acceptance-criteria tests present and passing in tank_data (32 total lib tests, 0 failures): test_provenance_schema_roundtrip (AC1), test_provenance_optional_fields (AC2), test_confidence_levels_enum (AC3), test_valid_range_enforcement (AC4), test_backward_compatible_loading (AC5), test_provenance_display (AC6).

11 provenance unit tests pass in tank_core covering ConfidenceLevel roundtrip/rejection, ParamMeta display (full/empty/notes), range check (in-range, out-of-range, no-range, non-finite, invalid range), and format_param (with and without notes).
ConfidenceLevel enum with Literature/Expert/Heuristic/Placeholder variants, serde lowercase roundtrip, unknown value rejection — all verified in provenance.rs.
ParamMeta struct with deny_unknown_fields and 5 optional fields (unit, source, confidence, valid_range, notes) — all with serde(default, skip_serializing_if) for backward compatibility.

RangeWarning struct with Display impl covering invalid ranges, non-finite values, and out-of-range values. check_param_range() and check_all_ranges() produce warnings (not errors), meeting the 'warning not hard failure' requirement.
format_param() developer-facing helper renders provenance entries clearly: 'param_name: value unit [confidence, source] range [lo, hi] notes: ...' — satisfying the display helper requirement.

Per-parameter param_meta (BTreeMap<String, ParamMeta>) now supported on all 5 preset types: ProcessParamsPreset, SourceWaterPreset, ShrimpPreset, PlantPreset, SubstratePreset — all via shared ParamMetaPreset trait with lookup_param_value(), format_param(), check_ranges(), unknown_param_meta_keys() methods.
Unknown param_meta key validation wired into all 5 preset validate() methods. ParamMeta uses deny_unknown_fields to catch metadata typos.

Legacy _mg/_mg_total migration verified: parse_process_params_preset() normalizes legacy keys via legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l (value / 20.0). Regression test at lib.rs:380 confirms aob_k_tan_mg=200.0 becomes aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l=10.0 with param_meta key migration.
All 5 preset loaders have diagnostic-aware variants (load_*_with_diagnostics) that surface range warnings as structured diagnostics. Standard loaders emit warnings to stderr.
4 tank_scenarios lib tests pass confirming scenario materialization compiles through updated preset APIs. 14 validation integration tests pass.
cargo clippy -p tank_data -- -D warnings and cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings both pass clean.

Backward compatibility confirmed: shipped TOML presets without param_meta load successfully (test_backward_compatible_loading + shipped_param_meta_loaders_return_no_diagnostics covering source_water, substrate, plant, shrimp, and process presets).
findings_or_gaps: No shipped TOML data files currently contain [param_meta.*] sections. The infrastructure is ready but actual metadata enrichment is deferred to downstream bead tanksim-6e5.7.2. This is by design — the current bead's scope is schema and loader support only.

Preset-level Provenance.confidence remains Option<String> rather than Option<ConfidenceLevel>. Documented as intentional (preset-level serves different granularity than per-parameter). Minor inconsistency but not a blocker.
Pre-existing cargo fmt issue in crates/tank_core/tests/plant_nutrient_normalization.rs from another bead — not introduced by this work.

Serde aliases on ProcessParams runtime struct (tank_core/src/types/process.rs:59-112) accept legacy _mg keys without the /20 normalization. Any codepath that deserializes directly via serde bypasses the parser-backed conversion. This is a known risk documented in prior review cycles; the loader path correctly normalizes but the alias-only path does not.
